item.name: Hotcakes
item.description: If you love hot pancakes, you've got to try McDonald's Hotcakes with a side of real butter and sweet maple flavored Hotcake syrup. Comes with 3 golden brown Hotcakes. Order them with a Premium Roast Coffee for the perfect breakfast combo.

item.name: Hotcakes and Sausage
item.description: When you're craving pancakes and sausage, McDonald's has you covered with our Hotcakes and Sausage breakfast. Featuring 3 golden brown Hotcakes and real butter, topped with sweet maple flavored hotcake syrup. On the side, you get a hot McDonald's sausage patty. Pair it with a Premium Roast Coffee for a perfect pancakes and sausage breakfast combo.

item.name: Oatmeal
item.description: Two full servings of whole-grain oats with a touch of cream and brown sugar. Loaded with red and green apples, cranberries, and two varieties of raisins, our oatmeal makes for a hearty, wholesome breakfast of whole grains and fruit. Enjoy this whole grain oatmeal for breakfast with a McCafé® Premium Roast Coffee to give a healthy start to your day.

item.name: Sausage Burrito
item.description: Start your day off with a loaded Egg and Sausage Burrito. Loaded with fluffy scrambled egg, pork sausage, melty cheese, green chiles, and onion! It's wrapped in a soft tortilla, making it the perfect grab and go breakfast. Enjoy it as a snack or grab a Sausage Burrito Meal with a crispy golden Hash Browns and a small McCafé® Premium Roast Coffee.

item.name: Premium Roast Coffee
item.description: Treat yourself to a cup of our simple, satisfying McCafé® Premium Roast Coffee. Made with 100% Arabica beans, McCafé® Premium Roast Coffee is expertly roasted and freshly brewed every 30 minutes. Enjoy your hot coffee black or with your choice of sugar, sweetener, and dairy or creamer.

item.name: Decaf Coffee
item.description: Savour the great tasting flavour you love, decaffeinated. Our coffee beans are naturally decaffeinated using the Swiss Water® Process, leaving only a quality Decaf coffee you can enjoy all day long.

item.name: Iced Coffee
item.description: Enjoy a refreshingly cool Iced Coffee! Made with 100% Arabica beans, cream, and your choice of flavored coffee syrup—Caramel, Hazelnut, French Vanilla, and Sugar-Free French Vanilla. A fan of black coffee? Get it without the sugar or cream to refresh your mornings with a cool Black Iced Coffee.

item.name: Iced Caramel Coffee
item.description: Enjoy a refreshingly cool Iced Caramel Coffee that features premium roast beans and buttery caramel flavor. It’s personalized with your choice of sweetener and creamer for a taste that’s unmistakably yours.

item.name: Iced Vanilla Coffee
item.description: Refreshingly cool iced coffee made with premium roast beans and smooth French vanilla flavor.

item.name: Premium Hot Chocolate
item.description: Taste the delicious chocolatey flavor of McCafé® Hot Chocolate. McDonald’s Hot Chocolate recipe features steamed whole milk with rich hot chocolate syrup and is finished with whipped light cream and chocolate drizzle.

item.name: Mocha Frappé
item.description: Cold and creamy Mocha Frappé made with rich chocolate flavor and a hint of coffee. Blended with ice and topped with whipped light cream and chocolatey drizzle.

item.name: Caramel Frappé
item.description: Rich caramel flavor and a hint of coffee, blended with ice, and topped with whipped topping and caramel drizzle.

item.name: Caramel Macchiato
item.description: Our McCafé® Caramel Macchiato recipe features rich, dark-roast espresso served with steamed whole milk, mixed with sweet caramel syrup.

item.name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
item.description: The McDonald's Iced Caramel Macchiato recipe is made with our rich, dark-roasted McCafe espresso and is served with whole milk, mixed with sweet caramel syrup. It is almost similar to Iced Caramel Latte but with an extra buttery caramel drizzle.

item.name: Mocha
item.description: Made from 100% Rainforest Alliance Certified espresso, steamed with whole or nonfat milk, chocolate syrup, topped with whipped cream and a chocolate drizzle.

item.name: Iced Mocha
item.description: Put a pep in your step with McDonald’s Iced Mocha Latte—Made with sustainably sourced espresso beans from Rainforest Alliance Certified™ farms, our refreshingly cool Iced Mocha Latte recipe is made with whole milk, chocolate syrup, and finished with whipped light cream and chocolate drizzle.

item.name: Latte
item.description: Our McCafé® Latte is made from Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso and steamed milk. Customize the Hot Latte that’s made fresh just for you with whole milk, mixed with your choice of flavor at certain locations.

item.name: Caramel Latte
item.description: Take a break and warm up with a cup of creamy McDonald's Caramel Latte. Our McCafé® Caramel Latte recipe is made with Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso, steamed milk, and a sweet, satisfying caramel flavor. The added caramel syrup makes it slightly sweeter than a regular McCafé® Latte.

item.name: Vanilla Latte
item.description: Warm up with a rich, creamy McCafé® French Vanilla Latte! Our McDonald’s French Vanilla Latte recipe features Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso, steamed whole milk and infused with a smooth French vanilla syrup.

item.name: Iced Latte
item.description: Cool down with a cold McCafé® Iced Latte at McDonald's. Our Iced Latte recipe combines espresso with cold whole milk, mixed with your choice of flavor at certain locations. Wondering what's the difference between an iced coffee and an iced latte? While iced coffee is made with brewed coffee, McDonald's Iced latte is made from Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso.

item.name: Iced Caramel Latte
item.description: Cool off with a refreshing McCafé® Iced Caramel Latte at McDonald's. Our Iced Caramel Latte recipe features Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso and buttery caramel flavor.

item.name: Iced Vanilla Latte
item.description: Cool down with a McCafé® Iced French Vanilla Latte, made with Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso. Our McDonald’s Iced Vanilla Latte recipe features bold espresso, whole milk and sweet French vanilla syrup.

item.name: Cappuccino
item.description: Enjoy a warm cup of Cappuccino from McDonald’s. Made with whole steamed milk, bold espresso made from sustainably sourced beans, foamed milk, and your choice of flavor. The ingredients are the same as that of a McCafé® Latte but the main difference between a latte and a cappuccino is that a cappuccino is distinctly layered and has a slightly stronger flavor than the latte.

item.name: Vanilla Cappuccino
item.description: Whole steamed milk, bold espresso made from sustainably-sourced beans, fluffy foam, and rich French Vanilla flavor.

item.name: Caramel Cappuccino
item.description: Enjoy a warm and comforting Caramel Cappuccino from McDonald’s. Our McCafé® Caramel Cappuccino recipe features whole steamed milk, bold espresso made from sustainably-sourced beans, fluffy foam, and buttery caramel flavor.

item.name: Americano
item.description: Start your mornings with a bold McCafé® Americano coffee that pairs perfectly with our breakfast menu items. Our simple yet satisfying Americano is made with hot water poured over our Rainforest Alliance Certified™ espresso.
